fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 remains linear in the emitted lifted symbols. The exact G13 affine coefficients, summing to one, carry any common-target linear syndrome to the honest target; repeating syndrome rows cannot charge this zero-residual affine lift, and no nonlinear polynomial-size exclusion mechanism is specified.

Proposal 2 never establishes the claimed conversion from a large Smith invariant to large Euclidean CVP distance. A divisibility obstruction can coexist with a short residual or DROP vector, while bounded Macaulay degree is incomplete and growing degree can require exponentially many monomials.

Proposal 3 provides no explicit formula-to-complex construction or reason integral signed chains cannot splice or cancel. Cosystolic expansion by itself concerns distance from cocycles and does not imply the asserted YES/NO filling-volume separation with a common prescribed boundary.

Proposal 4's fixed experiment reuses G38's full-variable artifact: on the four-variable instance, complete bags already force equality of global distributions. Scaling normalization rows therefore manufactures a predictable finite pass without testing the claimed logarithmic-bag scaling law, while G15-style zero-residual affine lifts remain unaddressed asymptotically.

Proposal 5 specifies neither a lattice family nor a theorem connecting exponentially many nearest vectors to a polynomial second-shell ratio. Searching unspecified Construction-A codes only through k=6 cannot discriminate the asymptotic claim, and a finite favorable ratio would establish nothing about polynomial growth.

Proposal 6 has an unresolved size-versus-linearity dichotomy: columns for complete words are exponential, whereas polynomial transition compilation linearizes into a signed-flow system vulnerable to G19. Truncated Magnus coordinates distinguish individual words, not unrestricted integral combinations, so free-group girth does not supply the required soundness.
evidence: G13 verified an exact integral affine collision on the 72 selectors over every tested modulus; G15 then lifted those coefficients through every hierarchy level with zero residual. These directly contradict reliance on compatible linear codes or marginal hierarchies.

G7 found a zero-residual signed selector that defeated every repeated radix row, and G19 found a zero-residual accepting signed flow with two negative coefficients. These show that residual amplification and ordered computation do not control unrestricted integral combinations.

G38 verified only a fixed shell: no obstruction vector through 181, control minimum 119, and DROP cost 417. Its proof relies on eleven bags containing all four variables, so it supplies no evidence for logarithmic-width bags on growing formulas.

G14 passed one complete pair-bag shell, but G15 subsequently exhibited a zero-residual affine hierarchy lift. Thus larger local views can improve a fixed shell without yielding composition or dimension-dependent separation.

G31's finite equal-radius pass failed to compose in G32, where compatible parity witnesses had exactly additive cost; G37 proved the same exact additive cut throughout its metric family. No proposal supplies a mechanism escaping this established composition blocker.

G28 failed its required growth inequality, and G30's tensor seed was exactly isometric to its control. None of the proposed experiments defines a new verified recurrence whose adverse growth can exceed legal growth.
